scope: Proposition 7.3 (Transfer to an open insertion) of the manuscript “A density-uniform condensate bound for dilute Bose gases” (preprints/A-density-uniform-condensate-bound-for-dilute-Bose-gases-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dceb5d5d293d6dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For any measurable symmetric slab event E, µab(E) ≤ C M2 Pcl(E)1/4 . (23) In particular, the insertion mass is at most C/M2 and the joint bound (22) transfers to this measure with exponent q |U|/4 cl and prefactor C/M2. All tests in this application use the actual inner endpoints.
